name: Casabianca (Colombia)
description: Horizontal bicolour of green and white, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Casabianca.
history: Municipal flag of Casabianca, a municipality in the department of Tolima, Colombia; Colombian municipal flags are adopted by agreement (acuerdo) of the municipal council or by decree of the mayor.

features.role: Casabianca arms — landscape, tools and clasped hands, within branches
